title: Functions [Date/Time + COALESCE]
description:
## Date/Time Functions
SQLite has built-in date functions:
- `DATE('now')` - current date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `TIME('now')` - current time (HH:MM:SS)
- `DATETIME('now')` - both combined
- `STRFTIME(format, date)` - custom format

```sql
SELECT DATE('now');              -- 2025-01-15
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', 'now');    -- 2025
```

## COALESCE
`COALESCE` returns the first non-NULL value from a list. Perfect for replacing NULLs with defaults.
```sql
SELECT COALESCE(NULL, NULL, 'fallback');  -- fallback
SELECT COALESCE(status, 'unknown') FROM servers;
```
If status is NULL, it shows 'unknown' instead.

## Assignment:
BWS has a tickets table where some tickets have no assigned_to. Select each ticket's title and use COALESCE to show the assigned_to name, or 'unassigned' if NULL, and alias it to assigned_to.
setupCode: CREATE TABLE tickets (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, assigned_to TEXT); INSERT INTO tickets VALUES (1, 'Disk full', 'Steve'), (2, 'Memory leak', NULL), (3, 'CPU spike', 'Alice'), (4, 'Ghost process', NULL);
expectedOutput:
title | assigned_to
Disk full | Steve
Memory leak | unassigned
CPU spike | Alice
Ghost process | unassigned
